entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""This appears to be a list of finan..."
entries.dialogueText: "This appears to be a list of financial transactions performed by Rizian Royal Gold on behalf of the Lespian government."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""However, most of the pertinent det..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, most of the pertinent details have been blacked out. We know that money was moved, but not to whom or for what purpose."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It doesn't matter. A traitor's a t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It doesn't matter. A traitor's a traitor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Rizian state owns a significan..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Rizian state owns a significant part of RRG. How could we have let this go undetected?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lespia has lied to us about a grea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lespia has lied to us about a great many things. Why not this?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Covering up Lespia's involvement i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Covering up Lespia's involvement in the Wehlen bombing was a huge favor. This is all we get in return?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Agreed. This document alone is mor..."
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed. This document alone is more than enough to put Montoro behind bars."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The information here is more than..."
entries.dialogueText: "The information here is more than enough to justify Mr. Montoro's arrest."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I agree. With this evidence, we ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. With this evidence, we can put Montoro behind bars and restore RRG's rightful ownership."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""A corporation as large as RRG perf..."
entries.dialogueText: "A corporation as large as RRG performs thousands of transactions per week. It's not unusual for one or two to fly under the radar."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Compromising Rizia's national secu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Compromising Rizia's national security right under our nose. The man deserves to rot."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It's not on par with Duchess Azaro..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not on par with Duchess Azaro's betrayal. But it's a flagrant breach of national security."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""This is an unforgivable security b..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is an unforgivable security breach, Your Majesty. Our forces should have been more vigilant."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""This document alone is more than e..."
entries.dialogueText: "This document alone is more than enough to put Montoro behind bars."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The information here is more than..."
entries.dialogueText: "The information here is more than enough to justify Mr. Montoro's arrest."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""*If* Lespia can be trusted, this d..."
entries.dialogueText: "*If* Lespia can be trusted, this document alone is enough to justify Mr. Montoro's arrest."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We've verified what little informa..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've verified what little information we could. It all checks out."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""At long last, the time has come.""
entries.dialogueText: "At long last, the time has come."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""On second thought, Rusty has prove..."
entries.dialogueText: "On second thought, Rusty has proven himself loyal to the Crown in the past. Perhaps he deserves a second chance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I confess I'm curious to hear Rust..."
entries.dialogueText: "I confess I'm curious to hear Rusty's side of the story."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Montoro's Arcasian guards can't sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Montoro's Arcasian guards can't save him now. The time has come to act."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The fault lies entirely with Mr. M..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fault lies entirely with Mr. Montoro. His Arcasian guards can't save him now. The time has come to act."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't say I'm happy about this r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't say I'm happy about this revelation. But I will enjoy hearing Rusty beg for his life."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I take no pleasure in this. We had..."
entries.dialogueText: "I take no pleasure in this. We had the chance to hold Lespia to account for its wrongdoing, and we gave it up just to reel in a small fish."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""If we spare him from arrest, perha..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we spare him from arrest, perhaps we can persuade him to hand them over."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Mr. Montoro may well still have ac..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Montoro may well still have access to the original copies of these files, or others that could expose the extent of Lespia's actions against us."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""We do have significant leverage ov..."
entries.dialogueText: "We do have significant leverage over Mr. Montoro now. If we were to spare him from arrest, we would secure his unconditional loyalty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I heard that he had a hand in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I heard that he had a hand in the Rizian National Coalition's election gains. But they would have won just as easily without him."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The only loyalty I've witnessed fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "The only loyalty I've witnessed from that man is his devotion to hideous cravats."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Whatever he may or may not have do..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever he may or may not have done in the past, sparing him from arrest would secure his and RRG's full cooperation in the future."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Perhaps he could even lead us to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps he could even lead us to the uncensored versions of these files."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""A lovely thought, Grand Wiseman. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "A lovely thought, Grand Wiseman. But now that Prime Minister Alvarez has given us evidence of Rusty's dealings with Lespia, he'll be expecting us to take swift action."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes, I don't even understand why w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I don't even understand why we're still talking about this. We should imprison Montoro and put his company under state control as soon as possible."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Swift action is certainly warrante..."
entries.dialogueText: "Swift action is certainly warranted. As is the immediate nationalization of Mr. Montoro's company."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""You've hit the nail on the head, E..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've hit the nail on the head, Esquibel. We imprison Montoro and put his company under state control. It's as simple as that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree completely. By order of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree completely. By order of the king, Russello Montoro is to be placed under immediate arrest."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""We do not know the circumstances u..."
entries.dialogueText: "We do not know the circumstances under which this lost soul acted. Forgiving him would surely bring us one step closer to Golconda."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sal nodded solemnly."
entries.dialogueText: Sal nodded solemnly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We won't arrest him yet. I want to..."
entries.dialogueText: "We won't arrest him yet. I want to see what information we can get out of him first."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mr. Montoro is more useful to me o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Montoro is more useful to me outside of prison than in it. We'll hold off on arresting him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Grand Wiseman Ignacius has spoken..."
entries.dialogueText: "Grand Wiseman Ignacius has spoken the truth. God rewards those who forgive."

entries.dialogueText: "I'll dispatch extra security forces to Bronaz. We'll watch his every move."

entries.title: Elena Werner: ""As am I.""
entries.dialogueText: "As am I."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""This information gives us signific..."
entries.dialogueText: "This information gives us significant leverage against his corporation. Perhaps a light touch is preferable to moving in with brute force."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""A lovely thought, Grand Wiseman. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "A lovely thought, Grand Wiseman. But more to the point, if we have the chance to trade our intelligence on Mr. Montoro for incriminating details regarding Lespia, we should do it."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Perhaps he could even provide us w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps he could even provide us with more damning evidence of Lespia's past misdeeds."

entries.speaker: Elena Werner
entries.title: Elena Werner: ""This appears to be a list referenc..."
entries.dialogueText: "This appears to be a list referencing payments tied to extensive re-training of former Rizian Royal Gold employees — employees who later secured key roles in our energy sector."

entries.title: Elena Werner: ""Although most of the pertinent det..."
entries.dialogueText: "Although most of the pertinent details have been blacked out, we suspect these transactions were performed by Mr. Montoro himself on behalf of the Lespian government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Such treachery to the Crown must n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such treachery to the Crown must not go unpunished."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If Lespia has been meddling in Riz..."
entries.dialogueText: "If Lespia has been meddling in Rizia's affairs, they shouldn't be allowed to get away with it."

entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Agreed. But our first step should..."
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed. But our first step should be to put Mr. Montoro behind bars and restore RRG's rightful ownership."
